item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine is striking Russian strategic sites, including a drone strike that killed a worker at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant and attacks on a St Petersburg plant that produces missile fuel, while Russia is hitting Ukrainian power facilities and the Northern Bridge with missiles and drones. Russia has begun rationing petrol after Ukrainian strikes damaged its second-largest refinery in Saratov, prompting Rosneft to cap sales, and a Russian FPV drone wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast. Russia’s leading independent newspaper has closed after an eviction, and leaked data suggest more than 400,000 Russian soldiers have been killed fighting in the war. The United Nations Security Council is monitoring the situation as peace talks are set to begin in Abu Dhabi. According to UCDP, 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024.

item.description:

A sand embankment collapsed in Gaza, killing a woman and injuring several people. Israeli forces deported fourteen foreign pro-Palestinian activists arrested in the West Bank during the olive harvest and seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens of residents. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli strikes have wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65-year-old retired engineer, and French investigators are probing alleged Israeli war crimes in the area. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and protests against Israeli attacks have taken place in Sweden. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The IRGC announced that its self-imposed limit on ballistic-missile range has been lifted and that it is constructing underground sites for weapons production and storage. Tehran delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pursues a gas-pipeline deal and sent a nuclear proposal to the United States via Qatar. item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation

Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh and the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina. A Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children, and a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital also killed 22 people. Saudi officials inspected Aramco facilities after Houthi damage, filmed strikes on Houthi missile production sites, and reported that the vital East-West pipeline was hit, while Pakistan condemned the attacks and Syria announced troops to Saudi Arabia. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
